title: Refinancing, hedge, and covenant economics
prompt:
Select among keeping existing debt and two refinancing structures on full economics and downside covenant feasibility.

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Model present-value principal, after-tax interest, gross time-zero fees, prepayment penalties, fee write-offs, and maturity terms; do not assume a tax shield on closing cash costs. Apply SOFR floors correctly, do not add floating interest to the all-in swapped rate, and use the controller-defined fixed-charge-coverage numerator and denominator before selecting the lowest-cost feasible structure.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also rebuild the five-year SOFR curve, rate-cap economics, amortization, break-even rate, and downside fixed-charge coverage.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `keep_existing_pv_cost`, `term_loan_A_pv_cost`, `term_loan_B_swap_pv_cost`, `recommended_structure`, `recommended_downside_interest`, `recommended_downside_fixed_charge_coverage`, `recommended_closing_leverage`, `pv_advantage_to_next_feasible`, `term_loan_A_five_year_after_tax_interest`, `term_loan_A_five_year_principal_repaid`, `sofr_breakeven_to_all_in_swap`, `term_loan_A_rate_cap_premium`, `term_loan_A_capped_downside_year1_interest`, `term_loan_A_capped_downside_fixed_charge_coverage`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
